ImageDescription.value: This Hazard Analysis looks at the range of potential hazards faced in Franklin County, Ohio. A hazard analysis provides information on the characteristics, location, extent of risk and vulnerability , and potential impact of each identified hazard. This is a critical first step in emergency/disaster planning. The hazards discussed in this document are those which historically happen, or could happen, in Franklin County. To determine the potential risk associated with each hazard, they have been rated on six common factors. The hazards' scores on each factor are compared with each other within each hazard group. A total score composite of all hazards is also analyzed.
